topics.topic: Rationale for the reorganization creating Morningstar Wealth Management, led by Daniel Needham, and how it involves Managed Portfolios, Retail (Morningstar.com), Direct Indexing, and ByAllAccounts
topics.stated_position: Management said changing investor demographics and preferences, advancing technological capabilities, and increasing investment options are significantly impacting the advisor client segment, and that the intent to bring these capabilities together "is all about removing friction and making it easier for advisors to respond to evolving end investor expectations." The launch of Morningstar Wealth Management combines Morningstar Managed Portfolios, Morningstar Office, ByAllAccounts, and Morningstar.com; management noted the initiative began in 2020 by bringing Morningstar Investment Management together with Office and ByAllAccounts to enhance practice management workflows.
topics.quote: By launching Morningstar Wealth Management with the combined solution-set of Morningstar Managed Portfolios, Morningstar Office, ByAllAccounts, and Morningstar.com we feel we are doing just that. Candidly, we’ve talked about doing this internally for a while now. In 2020, we began executing this initiative by bringing Morningstar Investment Management together with Office and ByAllAccounts to enhance practice management workflows so that advisors could increase their focus on delivering great financial advice.

topics.topic: Plans to address the direct indexing market
topics.stated_position: Management stated it plans to launch direct indexing capabilities through Morningstar Wealth Management's turnkey asset management platform (TAMP) later in 2022, "tapping into capabilities delivered through Morningstar Indexes and Sustainalytics," and anticipates the platform will be "a significant driver of growth for Morningstar in the years ahead."
topics.quote: We plan to launch direct indexing capabilities through Morningstar Wealth Management’s turnkey asset management platform (TAMP) later in 2022, tapping into capabilities delivered through Morningstar Indexes and Sustainalytics.

topics.topic: Characterisation of advisor client preferences and competitive positioning of an all-in-one platform
topics.stated_position: Management observed that independent advisors in particular favor "all-in-one" technology platforms that include practice, portfolio, and investment management/execution, allowing them to scale practices quickly and making it an easy way to transition businesses for those breaking away from a wirehouse.
topics.quote: We’ve observed that independent advisors, in particular, favor “all-in-one" technology platforms that include practice, portfolio, and investment management/execution. By doing so, they can scale their practices quickly, and for those who are breaking away from a wirehouse, it’s an easy way to transition their businesses.

notable_language.quote: Candidly, we’ve talked about doing this internally for a while now.
notable_language.why_notable: Unusually direct admission that the reorganization had been discussed internally for an extended period before being executed.

notable_language.quote: Empowering investor success is always at the core of our decision-making
notable_language.why_notable: Recurring mission-statement phrasing used to frame a structural reorganization decision.

notable_language.quote: All in, we’re excited about delivering a friction-free, comprehensive platform that will empower advisors to create value for the end investors they serve. In turn, we anticipate that this will be a significant driver of growth for Morningstar in the years ahead.
notable_language.why_notable: Forward-looking growth claim for the new Wealth Management platform, hedged with "we anticipate" — a benchmark against which later results can be measured.
